  README.md, LICENSE, CLAUDE.md, MEMORY.md, CONTRIBUTING.md

Targets in Package.swift (Task 1 declares all of them; each has a Tests/<Name>Tests target):

Target Imports Depends on Owner task VoyagerModel Foundation — 1 (JSONValue, AppLanguage), 4 Networking Foundation VoyagerModel 5 AuthCore Foundation, Security VoyagerModel 7 L10n Foundation (resources: Localizable.xcstrings) VoyagerModel 3 DesignSystem SwiftUI (resources: Colors.xcassets, Fonts/) — 2 Telemetry Foundation, SwiftUI, UIKit VoyagerModel 6 Domain Foundation VoyagerModel 9, 10, 11 VoyagerData Foundation VoyagerModel, Networking, AuthCore 12 SharedUI SwiftUI, SafariServices DesignSystem, L10n, Telemetry, VoyagerModel, Domain 13 VoyagerEnv SwiftUI everything above 14 SectionsUI SwiftUI, MapKit SharedUI, Domain, VoyagerModel 15, 26, 27, 28 NotificationsCore UserNotifications, BackgroundTasks VoyagerEnv 33 Feature* (17 targets: FeatureAuth, FeatureOnboarding, FeatureTrips, FeatureSearch, FeatureDiscover, FeatureCompare, FeatureImport, FeatureResults, FeaturePlan, FeatureShare, FeatureChat, FeatureAlerts, FeatureNearby, FeatureSettings, FeaturePreferences, FeatureAdmin, FeatureAccount) SwiftUI VoyagerEnv, SharedUI, SectionsUI (Results, Chat, Plan, Share, Trips), Domain 16–37, 47 AppShell SwiftUI every Feature*, NotificationsCore 16 TestSupport Foundation, SwiftUI VoyagerEnv, SnapshotTesting 14

Rule: features never import each other. Cross-feature navigation is env.router.open(Route) (Task 4). A dependency edge that is not in this table is a manifest change, and it goes through the controller as its own small PR.

docs.title: Task 1: Repo skeleton, CI pipeline, upstream vendoring, tool pins
docs.text:
Files: - Create: project.yml, Config/{Base,Debug,Release}.xcconfig, App/VoyagerApp.swift (placeholder WindowGroup { Text(verbatim: "Voyager") }), App/Resources/Assets.xcassets, App/Voyager.entitlements (empty dict), App/PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy (skeleton, Task 41 completes it) - Create: Packages/VoyagerKit/Package.swift with every target and test target from the table (swift-tools-version 6.0, defaultLocalization: "en", platforms: [.iOS(.v17)], swiftLanguageModes: [.v6]), a _Placeholder.swift in each target and a PlaceholderTests.swift (@Test func placeholder() { #expect(true) }) in each test target - Create: Packages/VoyagerKit/Sources/VoyagerModel/JSONValue.swift, AppLanguage.swift - Create: .github/workflows/ios-ci.yml, scripts/ci/*.sh (listed in the layout), .swiftlint.yml, tools.lock, upstream.lock, scripts/upstream/sync.sh, tools/export_registry.py, Upstream/**, scripts/fonts/fetch.sh - Create: docs/reference/api-contract.md, docs/reference/web-ui-inventory.md (copied from ~/travel-planner-android/docs/reference/, with "Android/Kotlin" changed to "mobile" in the title and a note that docs/API-Reference.md in travel-planner wins on conflict), README.md, LICENSE (MIT, rupakc), CLAUDE.md, MEMORY.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, .gitignore - Create: Packages/VoyagerKit/Tests/Fixtures/sse/{search_full,search_interrupted,chat_qa,chat_planning,chat_fallback}.sse (copied from ~/travel-planner-android/core/testing/src/main/resources/fixtures/) - Create: tools/golden/gen_golden.mjs (the golden-fixture generator used by Tasks 9–11), tools/golden/cases/.gitkeep, UITests/LaunchTests.swift (test_launches: the app launches and shows any window) - Test: Packages/VoyagerKit/Tests/VoyagerModelTests/JSONValueTests.swift, tools/tests/test_export_registry.py

Interfaces: - Produces: - public enum JSONValue: Codable, Sendable, Hashable { case null, bool(Bool), number(Double), string(String), array([JSONValue]), object([String: JSONValue]) }, with subscript(key: String) -> JSONValue (.null when it is absent or not an object), subscript(index: Int) -> JSONValue, and var string: String?, double: Double? (also parses a numeric string, like JS Number), int: Int?, bool: Bool?, array: [JSONValue]?, object: [String: JSONValue]?, isNull: Bool, isTruthy: Bool (JS truthiness). Encoding keeps the object's keys sorted (deterministic fixtures). - public enum AppLanguage: String, CaseIterable, Codable, Sendable { case en, es, de, fr, hi, zh, bn }, with nativeName: String (the exact native names above), bundleCode: String (zh → zh-Hans, otherwise the raw value), intlLocale: Locale (zh-CN, hi-IN, bn-IN, otherwise the code), static func from(preferred: [String]) -> AppLanguage (base tag: zh-TW → zh; unknown → en). - CI scripts: scripts/ci/test-unit.sh <iphone|ipad> [only_testing] (runs xcodebuild test -scheme VoyagerKit-Package -destination "$(scripts/ci/sim-destination.sh $1)" in Packages/VoyagerKit, writes build/unit-$1.xcresult, fails if the log has warning: in project sources), scripts/ci/test-ui.sh <iphone|ipad>, scripts/ci/build-sim.sh (Debug, -sdk iphonesimulator, CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO, zips Voyager.app to build/Voyager-sim.zip), scripts/ci/archive.sh (Release, generic/platform=iOS, CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO), scripts/ci/generate.sh (runs tools/gen_tokens.py and tools/gen_catalog.py when present, then xcodegen generate), scripts/ci/summarize.sh <xcresult> (prints suites, test counts and failures from xcrun xcresulttool get test-results summary). - upstream.lock: WEB_REPO=rupakc/travel-planner and WEB_SHA=<40-hex>. scripts/upstream/sync.sh [sha] makes a sparse, shallow fetch of frontend/src/i18n/locales, frontend/design/tokens.json and backend/app/telemetry/registry.py at that SHA into Upstream/, runs tools/export_registry.py to write Upstream/telemetry_registry.json, and updates upstream.lock. The tools CI job re-runs it at the pinned SHA and fails on git diff --exit-code Upstream/. - tools/export_registry.py <registry.py> <out.json>: loads the module by path (importlib.util.spec_from_file_location, no backend imports) and writes {"events": {name: {prop: type}}, "platforms": [...]} with sorted keys. sync.sh also copies the JSON to Packages/VoyagerKit/Tests/TelemetryTests/Resources/telemetry_registry.json (committed, covered by the same drift check). - node tools/golden/gen_golden.mjs <travel-planner checkout> [--check]: for each tools/golden/cases/<name>.json = {"module": "frontend/src/utils/<file>.js", "cases": [{"name", "fn", "args": [...]}]} it imports the module by file URL (bare imports resolve from the checkout's frontend/node_modules), calls fn(...args), and writes Packages/VoyagerKit/Tests/Fixtures/golden/<name>/<case>.json = {fn, args, output}. An arg {"$date": "<iso>"} becomes a Date. --check exits 1 on any difference. The tools job runs it with --check against a checkout of travel-planner at WEB_SHA (setup-node 20, npm ci in its frontend/) when tools/golden/cases has any case file.

  • [ ] Step 1: Write the failing tests. JSONValueTests: test_decodesNestedAndRoundTrips (decode {"a":[1,"2",null,true]} → re-encode equals the sorted-key string), test_doubleParsesNumericStrings ("12.5" → 12.5, "x" → nil), test_missingKeyIsNull, test_isTruthyMatchesJS (0, "", null, false are falsy; [] and {} are truthy). AppLanguageTests.test_fromPreferred (["zh-TW","en"] → .zh, ["pt-BR"] → .en). test_export_registry.py::test_exports_events_and_platforms (on the vendored registry.py: "screen_view" has {"route":"id","referrer_route":"id"}, and "ios" is in platforms).
  • [ ] Step 2: Write ios-ci.yml. Triggers: push (all branches), pull_request, workflow_dispatch with inputs only_testing (string, default "") and record_snapshots (boolean, default false). permissions: contents: read. concurrency: ios-ci-${{ github.ref }}, cancel in progress. env: XCODE_VERSION: "26.0.1". Jobs:
  • tools (ubuntu-24.04): setup-python 3.12, PY(tools/tests), shellcheck scripts/**/*.sh, the upstream drift check, and tools/gen_catalog.py --check / tools/gen_tokens.py --check when present (generated files must match their inputs).
  • lint (macos-15): scripts/ci/bootstrap.sh (downloads XcodeGen and SwiftLint from tools.lock URLs, checks SHA-256, puts them on PATH), then scripts/ci/lint.sh (swiftlint lint --strict).
  • unit (macos-15, matrix device: [iphone, ipad], needs: tools): bootstrap, select-xcode.sh, generate.sh, test-unit.sh ${{ matrix.device }} "${{ inputs.only_testing }}" with TEST_RUNNER_SNAPSHOT_RECORD=${{ inputs.record_snapshots && '1' || '' }}, then summarize.sh as step "Test summary". Upload the .xcresult on failure. When recording, upload Packages/VoyagerKit/Tests/**/__Snapshots__/** as artifact snapshots (iPhone job only; the iPad job uploads snapshots-ipad).
  • ui-smoke (macos-15, matrix [iphone, ipad], needs: unit, skipped when only_testing is set): test-ui.sh (Task 38 fills it; until then it runs a launch-only test).
  • sim-build (macos-15, needs: tools): build-sim.sh, upload Voyager-sim.zip (retention 14 days).
  • archive (macos-15, only on refs/heads/main, needs: [unit, ui-smoke]): archive.sh (proves the device build compiles; signing/TestFlight is Task 49).
  • Cache ~/Library/Developer/Xcode/DerivedData/**/SourcePackages and the tool downloads, keyed on Package.resolved + tools.lock.
  • [ ] Step 3: Write select-xcode.sh and sim-destination.sh. select-xcode.sh runs sudo xcode-select -s "/Applications/Xcode_${XCODE_VERSION}.app"; if that app is missing it lists /Applications/Xcode*.app and exits 1 (fix the pin in ios-ci.yml to an installed Xcode ≥ 26.0 at least 14 days old). sim-destination.sh iphone|ipad reads xcrun simctl list devices available -j and prints platform=iOS Simulator,id=<udid> for the first available of iPhone 16, iPhone 16 Pro, then any iPhone (for ipad: iPad Pro 13-inch (M4), iPad Air 11-inch (M2), then any iPad), on the newest iOS runtime.
  • [ ] Step 4: Write project.yml. options: {deploymentTarget: {iOS: "17.0"}, bundleIdPrefix: io.github.rupakc}. Target Voyager (application) with sources App, configFiles per configuration, packages: {VoyagerKit: {path: Packages/VoyagerKit}}, dependency on product AppShell, and info properties: CFBundleDisplayName: Voyager, CFBundleLocalizations: [en, es, de, fr, hi, zh-Hans, bn], UILaunchScreen: {UIColorName: LaunchBackground}, UISupportedInterfaceOrientations~ipad all four, UIApplicationSupportsMultipleScenes: false, NSAppTransportSecurity: {NSAllowsLocalNetworking: true}, ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption: false, VoyagerBaseURL: $(VOYAGER_BASE_URL), VoyagerTrustedHosts: $(VOYAGER_TRUSTED_HOSTS), CFBundleURLTypes with scheme voyager. Target VoyagerUITests (bundle.ui-testing). Schemes Voyager (build + run) and VoyagerUI (test VoyagerUITests).
  • [ ] Step 5: Pin the tools. tools.lock holds lines name version url sha256 for xcodegen 2.43.0 (https://github.com/yonaskolb/XcodeGen/releases/download/2.43.0/xcodegen.zip) and swiftlint 0.59.1 (portable_swiftlint.zip). Compute each SHA-256 locally with curl -sL <url> | shasum -a 256. In Package.swift, add .package(url: "https://github.com/pointfreeco/swift-snapshot-testing", exact: "1.18.3"), used only by TestSupport. Before committing, check on GitHub that each release is ≥ 14 days old; if one does not exist, take the newest release that does and is ≥ 14 days old, and record it in MEMORY.md.
  • [ ] Step 6: Vendor upstream. scripts/upstream/sync.sh $(git -C /Users/rupak/travel-planner rev-parse origin/main). Expected: Upstream/locales/{en,es,de,fr,hi,zh,bn}/*.json (13 namespaces each), Upstream/tokens.json and Upstream/telemetry_registry.json exist.
  • [ ] Step 7: Write .swiftlint.yml. Included paths App, Packages/VoyagerKit/Sources, UITests; excluded **/Generated. Custom rules no_raw_color, no_literal_text, no_print (print(), no_main_sync (DispatchQueue.main.sync), no_force_try_outside_tests. Opt-in force_unwrapping, implicitly_unwrapped_optional, fatal_error_message.
  • [ ] Step 8: Run PY(tools/tests), then CI(full). Expected: the first run is red only on the tests from Step 1 if they are not implemented yet. Implement JSONValue and AppLanguage, re-run, and expect every job green (ui-smoke runs launch-only, archive is skipped off main). If select-xcode.sh fails, fix the pin as Step 3 says.
  • [ ] Step 9: Commit. git add -A && git commit -m "chore: repo skeleton, CI on macos-15, upstream vendoring, tool pins"

docs.title: Task 2: Design tokens generator and DesignSystem
docs.text:
Files: - Create: tools/gen_tokens.py, tools/tests/test_gen_tokens.py - Create (generated, committed): Packages/VoyagerKit/Sources/DesignSystem/Resources/Colors.xcassets/**, Sources/DesignSystem/Generated/Palette.swift - Create: Sources/DesignSystem/{SemanticColors,SectionAccent,Typography,Spacing,Radius,Motion,ThemeController,ButtonStyles,FontRegistry}.swift, Sources/DesignSystem/Resources/Fonts/{Inter-Regular,Inter-Medium,Inter-SemiBold,Inter-Bold,Sora-SemiBold,Sora-Bold}.ttf + OFL.txt (via scripts/fonts/fetch.sh, checksums in tools.lock) - Test: Tests/DesignSystemTests/{ThemeControllerTests,PaletteTests}.swift

Interfaces: - Consumes: Upstream/tokens.json (palette, dark, semantic: 22 families × stops 50–950, plus white). - Produces: - gen_tokens.py [--check]: one colorset per <family>-<stop> plus white, with an any appearance (from palette) and a dark appearance (from dark), sRGB. Also Palette.swift: public enum Palette { public static func color(_ family: Family, _ stop: Stop) -> Color } and public enum Family: String, CaseIterable { case gray, slate, …, primary, accent }, public enum Stop: Int, CaseIterable { case s50 = 50, … , s950 = 950 }, public static let white: Color. --check exits 1 when the outputs differ from regeneration. - public enum SemanticColor { static let surface, surfaceRaised, text, textMuted, border, accent: Color }, mapped exactly as semantic in tokens.json (surface = gray-50, surface-raised = white, text = gray-900, text-muted = gray-500, border = gray-200, accent = accent-500). primary = primary-600 in light mode and primary-400 in dark (the Android mapping). - public enum SectionAccent { static func color(for section: String) -> Color }: flights sky, hotels violet, activities emerald, places_to_see lime, walking_tours teal, events fuchsia, visa amber, sim rose, tips amber, getting_around cyan, forex emerald, itinerary teal, stress_test rose, emergency_card red, packing_list teal, weather sky (stop 600 in light, 400 in dark); unknown → primary. - public enum ThemePreference: String, CaseIterable, Sendable { case system, light, dark }. @MainActor @Observable public final class ThemeController { public init(defaults: UserDefaults = .standard); public var preference: ThemePreference; public var colorScheme: ColorScheme? } (nil only for .system). It persists to tp_theme; the default with nothing stored, or with junk stored, is .light. - public enum VFont { static func display(_ style: Font.TextStyle) -> Font /* Sora */; static func body(_ style: Font.TextStyle, weight: VWeight = .regular) -> Font /* Inter */ }, using Font.custom(_:size:relativeTo:) so Dynamic Type scales. FontRegistry.registerOnce() registers the bundled TTFs with CTFontManagerRegisterFontsForURL(.process) and is idempotent. Devanagari, Bengali and Han glyphs fall back to the system fonts (Kohinoor, PingFang) through CoreText cascade, so no Noto download is needed. - Spacing (4/8/12/16/24/32), Radius (largeCard 24, itemCard 12, input 8, pill .infinity), Motion.standard(_ reduceMotion: Bool) -> Animation? (nil when Reduce Motion is on). - Button styles: PrimaryButtonStyle, SecondaryButtonStyle, TonalButtonStyle, DestructiveButtonStyle (44 pt minimum height).

docs.title: Task 3: String Catalog generator and L10n runtime
docs.text:
Files: - Create: tools/gen_catalog.py, tools/tests/test_gen_catalog.py - Create (generated, committed): Sources/L10n/Resources/Localizable.xcstrings, Sources/L10n/Generated/Keys.swift, App/Resources/InfoPlist.xcstrings - Create: Sources/L10n/{L10n,LKey,LanguageController,Formatters,MarkupString}.swift, i18n/pending/en/.gitkeep - Test: Tests/L10nTests/{LookupTests,PluralTests,FormatterTests,LanguageControllerTests}.swift

Interfaces: - Consumes: Upstream/locales/<lang>/<ns>.json (i18next JSON v4; nested keys; plurals _zero/_one/_two/_few/_many/_other; {{name}} placeholders; <tag> markup), i18n/pending/en/<ns>.json, and AppLanguage (Task 1). - Produces: - gen_catalog.py [--check] writes Localizable.xcstrings (sourceLanguage: "en", version: "1.0"). Each key is "<ns>:<dotted.path>" with the plural suffix stripped, and has extractionState: "manual" and one localization per language (zh → zh-Hans). - Plain strings become a stringUnit with state: "translated". - A plural group becomes value %#@count@ with a substitutions.count entry (argNum: 1, formatSpecifier: "lld") and one variations.plural form per suffix present. In those forms {{count}} becomes %arg and a literal % becomes %%. A form may omit %arg. - When a key is missing in a language, it takes the English value and is recorded in the generator's stderr report. - Pending keys exist only in en in their source; the generator gives every language their English value and prints pending: N keys. - Pending keys that collide with an upstream key make the generator fail. - Keys.swift: nested public enum K { public enum common { public enum nav { public static let search = LKey("common:nav.search", placeholders: [], plural: false) } } }. Identifiers are sanitised (- and . become _, a leading digit gets a _ prefix, Swift keywords are backticked). - InfoPlist.xcstrings comes from the mobile:infoPlist.* keys (Task 8): NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription ← mobile:infoPlist.location, CFBundleDisplayName stays "Voyager". Until Task 8's namespace is vendored, the generator emits a catalog with only CFBundleDisplayName and prints a notice instead of failing. - public struct LKey: Sendable, Hashable { public let id: String; public let placeholders: Set<String>; public let plural: Bool }. - public enum L10n { public static func text(_ key: LKey, _ args: [String: String] = [:], count: Int? = nil) -> String; public static func attributed(_ key: LKey, _ args: [String: String] = [:], count: Int? = nil, links: [String: URL] = [:]) -> AttributedString }. The lookup uses the LanguageController.current.bundleCode .lproj sub-bundle of Bundle.module, with fallback en. For a plural key it calls String.localizedStringWithFormat(format, count). Then it replaces each {{name}} from args (debug builds assert that the args match the placeholders). attributed turns <strong>…</strong> into bold, <a>/named tags in links into links, and drops any other tag but keeps its text. - @MainActor @Observable public final class LanguageController { public static let shared: LanguageController; public var language: AppLanguage /* persists tp_lang; default AppLanguage.from(preferred: Locale.preferredLanguages) */; public var locale: Locale /* language.intlLocale */ }. A thread-safe LanguageController.current: AppLanguage mirror is updated under OSAllocatedUnfairLock, so L10n.text can be called from any isolation. - public enum Fmt { static func number(_ n: Double, fractionDigits: Int? = nil) -> String; static func currency(_ amount: Double, code: String) -> String; static func date(_ d: Date, style: Date.FormatStyle.DateStyle = .abbreviated, time: Bool = false) -> String; static func relative(_ interval: TimeInterval) -> String /* under 60 s → "now" in the current language */ }. These follow LanguageController.current.intlLocale and never throw: a non-finite number gives "—" and a bad currency code shows "<code> <number>".

  • [ ] Step 1: Write the failing generator tests:
  • test_plain_key_flattened (common:nav.search → en "Search", de "Suche"), test_plural_becomes_substitution (common:nav.unread en has one/other with %arg unread, value %#@count@), test_bn_plural_forms_kept (every bn _one/_other maps).
  • test_percent_escaped_only_in_plurals, test_missing_key_falls_back_to_english (a temp de file with one key removed → that key's de value equals en, reported on stderr), test_pending_collision_fails, test_keys_swift_sanitises_identifiers (a.default → `default`, x.2fa → _2fa).

  • [ ] Step 3: Implement gen_catalog.py (stdlib json, sorted keys, 2-space indent, the same as Xcode's own output) and generate the outputs.
  • [ ] Step 4: Run PY(...). Expected: PASS.

  • LookupTests: test_englishDefault (L10n.text(K.common.nav.search) == "Search"), test_switchToGerman, test_interpolation (K.auth.comingSoon with provider: "Google" → "Google sign-in is coming soon — use your username and password for now."), test_attributedStrongBold.
  • PluralTests: test_frenchZeroIsOne (fr picks the _one form for 0), test_englishOther, test_bengaliOne.
  • FormatterTests: test_currencyDE (Fmt.currency(1234.5, code: "EUR") contains "1.234,50"), test_relativeNow, test_nonFiniteNumber.
  • LanguageControllerTests.test_persistsTpLang.

docs.title: Task 4: API models, repository protocols, navigation routes
docs.text:
Files: - Create: Sources/VoyagerModel/{TravelSearchRequest,Plans,Preferences,RecentSearch,Reference,Watches,Notifications,Devices,Nearby,LiveCheck,Discover,Compare,LinkImport,Feedback,Admin,Health,ClientConfig,Chat,SearchEvents,Repositories,Route}.swift - Test: Tests/VoyagerModelTests/{RequestEncodingTests,ResponseDecodingTests,StreamEventTests}.swift, fixtures Tests/Fixtures/json/*.json (one realistic response per endpoint, copied from docs/API-Reference.md examples)

Interfaces: - Consumes: JSONValue, AppLanguage. - Produces (all Codable, Sendable, Hashable, with snake_case CodingKeys, every response field optional unless the API marks it required, and decoding that tolerates unknown keys and numbers sent as strings): - TravelSearchRequest with every field in API-Reference §POST /api/search: origin, destination, departureDate, returnDate, nationality, interests, budgetUsd, numTravelers, adults, children, seniors, infants, accessibilityNeeds, residencePermits, existingVisas, destinations: [String]?, destinationNights: [Int]?, pace, serendipity, locale: AppLanguage?, mustInclude: [JSONValue]?, importSource: JSONValue?. Nil fields are omitted on encode. - PlanSummary, SavedPlan { id: Int, name, searchData: JSONValue, selections: JSONValue, createdAt, updatedAt, shareToken? }, NewPlan, PlanUpdate, SharedPlan; Preferences; RecentSearch { id: Int, search: JSONValue, lastUsedAt }; TasteProfile; AirportSuggestion, NationalitySuggestion; FareWatch, PriceWatch, WatchKind (flight|hotel|activity|trip), WatchPatch, NewFareWatch, NewPriceWatch, WatchMatchQuery; AppNotification, NotificationsPage { items, total, unread }; Device, DeviceRegistration { token, platform: String, locale? }; NearbyRequest, NearbyResponse, NearbySections; LiveCheckRequest, LiveCheckResult; DiscoverRequest, DiscoverSuggestion; CompareSummary; LinkImportRequest, LinkImportResult, ResolvePlaceRequest; FeedbackSubmission; AdminUser, NewAdminUser, FeedbackEntry, TelemetrySummary; Health { serpapiConfigured, pushConfigured, fareWatchAvailable, … }. - ClientConfig { publicBaseURL: URL?, telemetry: TelemetryRemoteConfig { enabled: Bool, flushIntervalS: Int, maxBatch: Int }, features: [String: JSONValue] }. - ChatRequest { messages: [ChatMessage], selections: JSONValue, searchResults: JSONValue, sessionContext: JSONValue, locale: AppLanguage? }. - Stream events decoded from one SSE data JSON object: public enum SearchStreamEvent: Sendable, Equatable { case section(type: String, source: SectionSource?, data: JSONValue); case agentStatus(agent: String, status: String); case done; case unknown(String) } with SectionSource: String { static, ai } and init(json: JSONValue). public enum ChatStreamEvent: Sendable, Equatable { case delta(String), suggestions([String]), sessionContextUpdate(JSONValue), planAction(action: String, field: String, data: JSONValue), planningStart(destination: String?), tripMap(JSONValue), itineraryGenerating, comprehensiveItinerary(JSONValue), agentStatus(agent: String, status: String), sectionResult(section: String, source: SectionSource?, data: JSONValue), importLink(url: String), planningDone, error(String), done, unknown(String) }. - Repository protocols (Sendable; every method async throws, untyped, so VoyagerModel does not depend on Networking. The live implementations in Task 12 throw APIError): PlansRepository { list() -> [PlanSummary]; get(id:) -> SavedPlan; create(_:) -> SavedPlan; update(id:_:) -> SavedPlan; delete(id:); share(id:) -> String; shared(token:) -> SharedPlan }, PreferencesRepository { get(); put(_:) -> Preferences; taste() -> TasteProfile; resetTaste(); setEmail(_ email: String) -> String? }, RecentSearchesRepository { list(); record(_ search: JSONValue); delete(id:) }, ReferenceRepository { airports(_ q: String, limit: Int) -> [AirportSuggestion]; nationalities(_ q: String, limit: Int) -> [NationalitySuggestion] }, SearchRepository { func stream(_ request: TravelSearchRequest) -> AsyncThrowingStream<SearchStreamEvent, Error> }, ChatRepository { func stream(_ request: ChatRequest) -> AsyncThrowingStream<ChatStreamEvent, Error> }, AgentsRepository { filtered(_ section: FilterableSection, request: TravelSearchRequest, filters: JSONValue) -> JSONValue; fareCalendar(_:) -> JSONValue; stressTest(itinerary: JSONValue, request: TravelSearchRequest) -> JSONValue; layover(_:) -> JSONValue } with FilterableSection: String { flights, hotels, activities }, DiscoverRepository, CompareRepository { summary(_ request: TravelSearchRequest) -> CompareSummary }, ImportRepository { extract(_:) -> LinkImportResult; resolvePlace(_:) -> JSONValue }, WatchesRepository { fareWatches(); priceWatches(kind: WatchKind?); createFare(_:); createPrice(_:); match(_ q: WatchMatchQuery) -> JSONValue?; patch(kind:id:_:); delete(kind:id:); check(kind:id:); liveCheck(_:) -> LiveCheckResult }, NotificationsRepository { page(unreadOnly: Bool, limit: Int, offset: Int) -> NotificationsPage; unreadCount() -> Int; markRead(ids: [Int]?, all: Bool) -> Int }, NearbyRepository { nearby(_:) -> NearbyResponse }, DevicesRepository { register(_:) -> Device; list() -> [Device]; delete(id:); unregister(token:) }, FeedbackRepository { submit(_:) }, AdminRepository { users(); create(_:); deactivate(_:); reactivate(_:); resetPassword(_:newPassword:); feedback(page:category:minRating:); telemetrySummary(days:) }, HealthRepository { health() -> Health; clientConfig() -> ClientConfig? /* nil on 404 */ }. - public enum WatchRequest: Sendable, Hashable { case fare(JSONValue), hotel(JSONValue), activity(JSONValue), trip(JSONValue) } (the item or search data to watch; used by SectionsUI and WatchCreateCoordinator). - public enum AppTab: String, CaseIterable, Sendable { case trips, explore, alerts, you } (Play is reserved for Phase 5). public enum ExploreMode: String, CaseIterable, Sendable { case search, chat, compare, link, discover }. public enum Route: Hashable, Sendable { case tab(AppTab), explore(ExploreMode), results(TravelSearchRequest), planDetail(id: Int), myPlan, alerts(kind: WatchKind?, watchID: Int?), notifications, nearby, settings, preferences, tasteProfile, admin, changePassword(forced: Bool), onboarding(fromSettings: Bool), share(token: String), importLink(URL?) }. @MainActor public protocol AppRouting: AnyObject { func open(_ route: Route) }. - public enum TelemetryRouteName { static func template(for route: Route) -> String }: /trips, /explore/search, /chat, /results, /plans/:id, /my-plan, /alerts, /alerts/:id, /notifications, /nearby, /settings, /preferences, /taste, /admin, /change-password, /onboarding, /share/:token, /import. Ids and tokens are never included.

docs.title: Task 5: Networking: APIClient, errors, SSE, server environment
docs.text:
Files: - Create: Sources/Networking/{APIClient,Endpoint,APIError,ErrorMapping,AccessTokenProvider,ServerEnvironment,SSEParser,SSELineSplitter,SSEClient,APIObserver,Timeouts}.swift - Test: Tests/NetworkingTests/{SSEParserTests,SSEClientTests,APIClientTests,ErrorMappingTests,ServerEnvironmentTests}.swift, Tests/NetworkingTests/Support/StubURLProtocol.swift

Interfaces: - Consumes: JSONValue, Upstream-independent; fixtures Tests/Fixtures/sse/*.sse. - Produces: - public protocol AccessTokenProvider: Sendable { func currentToken() async -> String?; func unauthorized(token: String) async -> Bool /* true = a fresh token now exists, retry once */ }. - public struct Endpoint<Response: Decodable & Sendable>: Sendable { method: HTTPMethod; path: String; query: [URLQueryItem]; body: (any Encodable & Sendable)?; auth: AuthMode (.none, .optional, .required); timeout: TimeoutClass (.standard 30 s, .ai 300 s); telemetryName: String /* route template such as "/api/plans/:id" */ }, plus Endpoint<Empty> for 204 responses. - public actor APIClient { public init(server: ServerEnvironment, tokens: AccessTokenProvider, session: URLSession = .shared, observer: APIObserver? = nil); public func send<R>(_ e: Endpoint<R>) async throws -> R; public func raw(_ e: Endpoint<JSONValue>) async throws -> (JSONValue, HTTPURLResponse) }. JSON decoding runs inside the actor. A 401 calls tokens.unauthorized(token:) with the token the request carried and retries once only on true. - public enum APIError: Error, Sendable, Equatable { case unauthorized, forbidden(String?), notFound(String?), rateLimited(message: String, retryAfter: Int?), client(status: Int, detail: String?, code: String?, body: JSONValue), server(status: Int, detail: String?), network, interrupted, decoding, notConfigured, cancelled }. var userFacingDetail: String? is the server detail string only: a list or object detail gives its message, or nil. Client-side errors never carry exception text. - ErrorMapping.map(status:body:headers:) -> APIError. detail may be a string, a list (422) or {code, message}. A 429 keeps the backend string as-is and reads Retry-After. An HTML 200 where JSON was expected (a captive portal) is .decoding. - public struct SSEMessage: Sendable, Equatable { public let data: String }. SSELineSplitter splits a byte stream on , and and keeps empty lines; AsyncBytes.lines is not used because it drops blank lines. SSEParser follows the rules in Android docs/Networking-and-SSE.md: data: lines are joined by and dispatched on a blank line; lines starting with : and the event:, id: and retry: lines are ignored; a final event without its blank line is delivered at end of stream. - public struct SSEClient: Sendable { public func stream(path: String, body: some Encodable & Sendable, auth: AuthMode) -> AsyncThrowingStream<JSONValue, Error> }. It uses URLSession.bytes(for:) with timeoutIntervalForRequest = 600 and no resource timeout, and parsing plus JSONDecoder run in a detached task at .userInitiated priority (never on the main actor). An HTTP status ≥ 400 before the stream starts maps through ErrorMapping. Task cancellation cancels the URLSession task. A stream that ends without a terminal event finishes normally; detecting a missing done belongs to the caller. - public final class ServerEnvironment: Sendable { public init(buildBaseURL: URL?, trustedHosts: Set<String>, allowsOverride: Bool, defaults: UserDefaults); public var baseURL: URL? { get }; public func setOverride(_ url: URL?) throws /* Debug only; http allowed only for localhost, 127.0.0.1, *.local and RFC 1918 hosts */; public func adopt(publicBaseURL: URL) /* switch only when https and host ∈ trustedHosts */ }. State lives under OSAllocatedUnfairLock. A nil baseURL makes every call throw .notConfigured. - public protocol APIObserver: Sendable { func didFail(endpoint: String, status: Int) } (telemetry hook, Task 14).

  • [ ] Step 1: Write the failing tests:
  • SSEParserTests: test_fixtureSearchFullYieldsEveryEvent (event count equals the count of data: lines in the file), test_commentsIgnored, test_multiDataLinesJoined, test_finalEventWithoutBlankLine, test_crlfAndCR, test_splitAcrossChunks (feed bytes 1 at a time).
  • SSEClientTests (StubURLProtocol streaming the fixture in 7-byte chunks): test_streamsAllEvents, test_http429BeforeStreamMapsRateLimited, test_cancellationStopsTask, test_parsingNotOnMainThread (record Thread.isMainThread inside the parser hook → false).
  • APIClientTests: test_bearerAddedWhenRequired, test_optionalAuthWithoutToken, test_unauthorizedRetriesOnceWhenProviderRefreshes, test_staleUnauthorizedIgnored (the provider gets the stale token, returns false, and the error is .unauthorized without a second request), test_404ConfigIsNotFound, test_observerGetsTemplateNotPath (/api/plans/:id, never /api/plans/42).
  • ErrorMappingTests: string, list and object detail, 429 with Retry-After: 42, HTML 200.
  • ServerEnvironmentTests: test_adoptRequiresTrustedHttps, test_overrideRejectsPublicHttp, test_nilBaseURLNotConfigured.
  • [ ] Step 2: Run CI(NetworkingTests). Expected: FAIL.
  • [ ] Step 3: Implement Networking.
  • [ ] Step 4: Run CI(NetworkingTests). Expected: PASS.
  • [ ] Step 5: Commit. git commit -m "feat(networking): APIClient, error mapping, SSE over URLSession.bytes off-main"

docs.title: Task 6: Telemetry SDK
docs.text:
Files: - Create: Sources/Telemetry/{Telemetry,TelemetryEvent,Envelope,PropsFilter,Consent,EventQueue,QueueStore,Gzip,Transport,Session,ColdStart,ViewModifiers}.swift - Test: Tests/TelemetryTests/{TelemetryEventTests,RegistryParityTests,PropsFilterTests,ConsentTests,TelemetryQueueTests,GzipTests,TelemetryClientTests}.swift

Interfaces: - Consumes: AppLanguage; Tests/TelemetryTests/Resources/telemetry_registry.json (written by sync.sh, Task 1; Package.swift declares it as a .copy resource of TelemetryTests). - Produces: - public enum TelemetryEvent: Sendable { case appOpen, appBackground, screenView(route: String, referrer: String?), screenTime(route: String, ms: Int), uiTap(tid: String, route: String), uiToggle(tid: String, route: String, on: Bool), uiChange(tid: String, route: String), uiSubmit(tid: String, route: String), searchSubmit(mode: ExploreModeName, travelers: Int, nights: Int, multiCity: Bool), searchFirstSection(ms: Int), searchComplete(ms: Int, sections: Int, errors: Int), searchAbandon(ms: Int, sections: Int), sectionExpand(section: String), planSelect(section: String), linkOut(section: String, domain: String), share(target: String, object: String), alertEvent(action: String, kind: String), onboardingStep(step: Int, action: OnboardingAction), featureUsed(feature: String, page: String), themeChange(String), languageChange(AppLanguage), consentGranted, perf(metric: PerfMetric, value: Double, route: String), apiError(source: String, status: Int) }. session_start is emitted internally. Event names and prop names are exactly the registry's: referrer_route, multi_city, consent → {choice: "granted"}, error → {kind: "api", source, status}. PerfMetric is a subset of the registry enum: ttfb, cold_start, long_task. ExploreModeName is search|chat|compare|link|discover, and OnboardingAction is view|next|skip|done. - public final class Telemetry: Sendable { public static let shared: Telemetry; public func configure(_ c: TelemetryBootstrap); public func track(_ e: TelemetryEvent) /* nonisolated, synchronous, never throws, O(1) */; public func setConsent(_ granted: Bool); public var consentChoice: ConsentChoice? { get }; public var requiresConsentPrompt: Bool { get }; public func didEnterBackground() async /* flush with the token, persist the remainder */; public func flushPersisted() async /* BGTask entry */ }. - public struct TelemetryBootstrap: Sendable { appVersion: String; locale: @Sendable () -> String; endpoint: @Sendable () -> URL? /* base + /api/telemetry */; token: @Sendable () async -> String?; remote: TelemetryRemoteConfig? /* nil = /api/config was 404 or failed → disabled */; storeDirectory: URL; now: @Sendable () -> Date; timeZone: @Sendable () -> TimeZone; transport: TelemetryTransport }. - public protocol TelemetryTransport: Sendable { func post(_ url: URL, body: Data, gzipped: Bool, token: String?) async -> TransportOutcome }, with TransportOutcome { case ok, disabled /* 404 */, retryAfter(Int), drop /* other 4xx except 408 and 429 */, failed }. URLSessionTelemetryTransport uses an ephemeral session with a 10 s timeout and Content-Encoding: gzip when gzipped. - Client rules, copied from docs/Telemetry.md: - remote == nil or enabled == false turns telemetry off for the process. - Flush every flushIntervalS (15) or at maxBatch (50, clamped to 100). - The queue is capped at 500. It is persisted to <storeDirectory>/tq.json only on background or after a failed send, and claimed at the next start. Stored events older than 7 days are discarded. - After three failures in a row, back off exponentially (30 s doubling, max 30 min). retryAfter is honoured. - anon_id is a UUID in UserDefaults tp_anon. The session id rolls over after 30 min idle, and session_start is emitted when it does. - Bodies over 1 KB are gzipped. - The work runs on a private serial DispatchQueue at .utility QoS. track only appends under OSAllocatedUnfairLock. - PropsFilter.token(_:) -> String? (^[A-Za-z0-9_.:/-]{1,64}$), int (|n| ≤ 2^53, not a Bool), float (finite), bool, enum. Failing props are dropped before queueing. - public enum Consent { static func required(timeZone: String) -> Bool }: true for every Europe/* zone except Istanbul, Moscow, Minsk, Kiev and Kyiv, and for Atlantic/{Reykjavik,Canary,Madeira,Azores,Faroe}. The choice is stored in UserDefaults tp_consent (granted/denied). Telemetry is allowed when the choice is granted, or when there is no choice and consent is not required. A denial clears the queue and sends nothing; a grant emits consent{choice: granted}. - Gzip.compress(_ data: Data) -> Data: RFC 1952 header 1f 8b 08 00 00000000 00 ff, the raw deflate from (data as NSData).compressed(using: .zlib), then CRC-32 (IEEE, table-driven) and ISIZE, little-endian. - ColdStart.markFirstFrame(): the process start time comes from sysctl KERN_PROC_PID p_starttime. The first call emits perf{metric: cold_start, value: ms, route: "/"}; later calls do nothing. - SwiftUI modifiers: .telemetryScreen(_ template: String) (screen_view on appear with the previous route as referrer; screen_time on disappear and on background), .telemetryToggle(tid:value:).

  • [ ] Step 1: Write the failing tests:
  • RegistryParityTests.test_everyCaseIsInRegistry (encode one sample of each case → its event is in the registry, each prop key is declared for it, and each value passes the declared type; enum values are members).
  • PropsFilterTests: test_emailRejected ("jane@x.com" → nil), test_spaceRejected, test_65CharsRejected, test_boolNotInt.
  • ConsentTests: test_euZones (Europe/Berlin true, Europe/Istanbul false, Atlantic/Canary true, America/New_York false, "" false), test_denialClearsQueueAndSendsNothing, test_grantSendsConsentEvent.
  • TelemetryQueueTests: test_capAt500DropsOldest, test_persistOnlyOnBackgroundOrFailure, test_discardsOlderThan7Days, test_writeFailureSwallowed (read-only directory → no throw, and track still works).
  • GzipTests: test_crc32KnownVector ("123456789" → 0xCBF43926), test_roundTripViaDecompress (strip the 10-byte header and 8-byte trailer, decompressed(using: .zlib) equals the input), test_headerBytes.
  • TelemetryClientTests (fake transport + manual clock): test_disabledWhenRemoteNil, test_404DisablesForSessionNoRetry (exactly one post, then none), test_flushAt50, test_flushEvery15s, test_backoffAfterThreeFailures, test_retryAfterHonoured, test_400DropsBatch, test_sessionRollsAfter30MinIdle (emits session_start), test_trackIsCheap (10 000 track calls in < 50 ms on the simulator).
  • [ ] Step 2: Run CI(TelemetryTests). Expected: FAIL.
  • [ ] Step 3: Implement the SDK.
  • [ ] Step 4: Run CI(TelemetryTests). Expected: PASS.
  • [ ] Step 5: Commit. git commit -m "feat(telemetry): closed-schema client, consent, offline queue, gzip"

docs.title: Task 7: AuthCore: session, Keychain, provider catalogue, Phase 1 seams
docs.text:
Files: - Create: Sources/AuthCore/{Session,User,AuthAPI,SessionStore,KeychainSessionStore,TokenRefresher,AuthProviders,SocialSignIn,AuthState,AccountCapabilities}.swift - Test: Tests/AuthCoreTests/{AuthStateTests,KeychainSessionStoreTests,AuthProvidersTests}.swift

Interfaces: - Consumes: VoyagerModel. - Produces: - public struct User: Codable, Sendable, Equatable { username: String; isAdmin: Bool; requiresPasswordChange: Bool; email: String? }, public struct LoginResponse: Codable, Sendable { accessToken: String; tokenType: String; user: User }. - public enum SignInMethod: String, Codable, Sendable { case password, apple, google, facebook, github }. public struct Session: Codable, Sendable, Equatable { accessToken: String; refreshToken: String?; accessExpiresAt: Date?; user: User; method: SignInMethod }. refreshToken stays nil until Phase 1. accessExpiresAt is read from the JWT exp without verifying it. - public protocol AuthAPI: Sendable { func login(username: String, password: String) async throws -> LoginResponse; func changePassword(current: String, new: String) async throws -> String /* new token */; func me() async throws -> User; func providers() async throws -> [AuthProviderInfo] }. Phase 1 adds methods through the separate protocols SignUpAPI, PasswordResetAPI, OAuthAPI, AppleSignInAPI, RefreshAPI and AccountDeletionAPI, declared now with no conformers so later waves fill them in. Each one's methods are listed in Task 43–47's "Gate" step, and the shapes come from the Phase 1 contract. - public protocol SessionStore: Sendable { func load() -> Session?; func save(_ s: Session) throws; func clear() }. KeychainSessionStore(service: "io.github.rupakc.travelplanner.session") uses kSecClassGenericPassword with kSecAttrAccessibleAfterFirstUnlockThisDeviceOnly and stores the JSON of the session. On first launch after install (UserDefaults tp_installed missing) it clears any leftover item and then sets the flag. - public protocol TokenRefresher: Sendable { func refresh(_ s: Session) async throws -> Session }. NoTokenRefresher always throws AuthError.refreshUnavailable. - public enum AuthProviderID: String, CaseIterable, Sendable { case apple, google, facebook, github } in web display order, with displayName "Apple"/"Google"/"Facebook"/"GitHub" (never translated). public struct AuthProviderInfo: Codable, Sendable { id: AuthProviderID; configured: Bool; startURL: URL? }. - public actor AuthProviderCatalog { public init(api: AuthAPI); public func providers() async -> [AuthProviderID: AuthProviderInfo] }. It caches for the process. A 404 or any error gives all four providers configured: false, without retry. - public protocol SocialSignIn: Sendable { func signIn(_ provider: AuthProviderID, info: AuthProviderInfo) async throws -> Session }. ComingSoonSocialSignIn always throws AuthError.comingSoon(provider), and so does every provider whose configured == false. - public enum AuthError: Error, Equatable { case invalidCredentials, comingSoon(AuthProviderID), refreshUnavailable, sessionExpired }. - @MainActor @Observable public final class AuthState { public init(api: AuthAPI, store: SessionStore, refresher: TokenRefresher = NoTokenRefresher(), social: SocialSignIn = ComingSoonSocialSignIn()); public private(set) var session: Session?; public var phase: AuthPhase /* .signedOut(reason: SignOutReason?), .needsPasswordChange, .signedIn */; public func signIn(username: String, password: String) async throws; public func signIn(with provider: AuthProviderID, info: AuthProviderInfo) async throws; public func changePassword(current: String, new: String) async throws; public func signOut() async; nonisolated public func tokenSnapshot() -> String? }. SignOutReason is .userInitiated or .sessionExpired. - extension AuthState: AccessTokenProvider is not here (no Networking dependency). Task 14 adapts it: unauthorized(token:) signs out with .sessionExpired only when token == session?.accessToken; a refresher is tried first. - public struct AccountCapabilities: Sendable { signUp: Bool; passwordReset: Bool; deleteAccount: Bool; refreshTokens: Bool }, all false in Phase 0. static func from(config: ClientConfig?) -> AccountCapabilities reads features.signup, features.password_reset, features.account_deletion and features.refresh_tokens, the keys Phase 1 is expected to add. A key that is missing reads as false.

  • [ ] Step 1: Write the failing tests:
  • AuthStateTests (fake API and in-memory store): test_signInStoresSession, test_requiresPasswordChangePhase, test_changePasswordReplacesToken, test_signOutClears, test_unauthorizedForCurrentTokenExpires (phase .signedOut(reason: .sessionExpired)), test_unauthorizedForStaleTokenIgnored, test_socialComingSoon (signIn(with: .google, info: unconfigured) throws .comingSoon(.google) and the session is unchanged).
  • KeychainSessionStoreTests: test_roundTrip, test_freshInstallClearsLeftover.
  • AuthProvidersTests: test_404MeansAllUnconfigured, test_listMerged (the API returns only google configured → the other three are unconfigured), test_cachedNoSecondCall.
  • [ ] Step 2: Run CI(AuthCoreTests). Expected: FAIL.
  • [ ] Step 3: Implement AuthCore.
  • [ ] Step 4: Run CI(AuthCoreTests). Expected: PASS.
  • [ ] Step 5: Commit. git commit -m "feat(auth): session store in Keychain, provider catalogue, Phase 1 seams"

docs.text:

It is never stored." - mobile:permissions.{notificationsTitle,notificationsBody,allow,notNow,locationTitle,locationBody,openSettings}. - mobile:session.expired = "Your session expired. docs.title: Wave 4 (after Wave 3 and the Task 8 upstream sync; Tasks 16–37 in parallel)
docs.text:
Rules for every task in this wave:

  • Replace only the files of your own target (or the stub files named for you). Start each View with .telemetryScreen(TelemetryRouteName.template(for: <route>)).
  • Give every control a tid named <area>.<thing>, reusing the web's data-tid value where the web has the control.
  • Take strings from the web namespace that the web page or component uses, given per task. A key the web lacks goes into i18n/pending/en/<ns>.json (English only); Task 41 upstreams those keys.
  • Provide iPhone (compact) and iPad (regular) layouts.
  • Ship at least one snapshot test per screen state (iPhone SE + iPad, light + dark) and unit tests for the screen's @Observable model, run against AppEnvironment.fake.
  • Verification is CI(Feature<X>Tests), then CI(full) before the final commit.

Interfaces: - Consumes: every entry view (Task 14), BackgroundTasks.register(env:) / schedule() (the Task 14 stub, which Task 33 replaces). - Produces: - RootView(env:). AuthGate order: if not signed in → LoginView; if .needsPasswordChange → ChangePasswordView(forced: true); if !env.device.onboardingCompleted → OnboardingView(fromSettings: false); otherwise the shell. The share viewer and the public share deep link work signed out, like the web's SharePage. - The shell: - compact width: a TabView with Trips, Explore, Alerts (badge = unread count, polled every 60 s while active) and You; - regular width: a NavigationSplitView sidebar with the same four items plus the Explore modes as sub-rows, a content column and a detail column. - Each tab keeps its own NavigationStack path. - Route.myPlan opens MyPlanView as a sheet in compact width and an .inspector in regular width, so Results, Chat and Trips reach it through the router without importing FeaturePlan. - ExploreContainer: a segmented picker over ExploreMode (web order: Search, Chat, Compare, From a link ✨, Surprise me), hosting the entry views, plus a Near me toolbar button. - AppRouter: AppRouting: open(_:) switches tab, pushes the route and emits screen_view via the destination's modifier. - DeepLinks.route(for url: URL) -> Route?: voyager://share/<token>, https://<trusted host>/share/<token>, /alerts?watch=<id>, /alerts?kind=<k>&watch=<id> (the push and notification links), and voyager://import?url=…. docs.text:
Files: Sources/FeatureResults/{ResultsView,ResultsModel,ResultsReducer,ResultsHeader,SectionsList,SectionDetailColumn,PlanToolsPanel /* stub owned by Task 25 */}.swift. Test: Tests/FeatureResultsTests/{ResultsReducerTests,ResultsModelTests,ResultsSnapshotTests}.swift

Interfaces: - ResultsReducer (pure): reduce(_ state: ResultsState, _ e: SearchStreamEvent) -> ResultsState, ResultsState { sections: [SectionID: (status: SectionStatus, data: JSONValue?)], confidence: JSONValue?, pricing: JSONValue?, done: Bool }. It implements the web status machine from api-contract §3.2: - initial: 13 sections loading; itinerary, stress_test and packing_list waiting. - static → enhancing; ai or no source → done. An ai error never replaces existing good data, and the static data stays. - A repeated type replaces the earlier one. - itinerary → loading once activities and hotels are done or enhancing; stress_test → loading after the itinerary is done. - Unknown types are ignored. On stream end every non-done section becomes done. - If no itinerary arrived, it falls back to the client itinerary built from activities and hotels (port the web fallback into this file). - @MainActor @Observable final class ResultsModel { init(env: AppEnvironment, request: TravelSearchRequest); state: ResultsState; interrupted: Bool; func start(); func cancel() }: - It consumes repos.search.stream in a Task, applying the reducer off the main actor and publishing on the main actor. - A stream that ends without done, or throws .network/.interrupted, is retried once and replays into the existing state; after that, interrupted = true shows the web's interrupted copy. - Telemetry: perf(metric: .ttfb, value:, route: "/results") at the first byte, searchFirstSection(ms) at the first section, searchComplete(ms, sections, errors) at done, searchAbandon(ms, sections) only if the view goes away before done. - env.plan.latestResults and searchData are updated as sections arrive. - The model is owned by ResultsView via @State, created once per request, so a size-class change keeps the stream. - LiveRegion.announce per finished section ("Hotels ready"). - Layout: on iPhone, a LazyVStack of SectionCards through SectionRegistry; on iPad, sections in the content column and the selected section in the detail column. ResultsHeader shows the route, dates and ConfidenceHeaderView. A "My Plan" toolbar button with the count calls router.open(.myPlan) (the shell presents it). Watch taps call env.watches.handle and show the result as a Toast.

  • [ ] Step 1: Write the failing tests:

  • ResultsModelTests: test_interruptedStreamRetriesOnceAndKeepsSections (the fake throws after 5 events, the retry replays the full fixture, no section is duplicated and static data is kept), test_secondInterruptionSetsInterrupted, test_modelSurvivesViewRebuild (re-render with another size class → same model instance and no second stream call), test_abandonOnlyBeforeDone, test_firstSectionTimingSentOnce.

docs.title: Task 38: UI smoke suite on iPhone and iPad against a stub backend
docs.text:
Files: tools/stub_backend/{server.py,routes.json}, tools/tests/test_stub_backend.py, UITests/{SmokeTests,Screens}.swift, scripts/ci/test-ui.sh

Interfaces: - server.py --port 8765 --fixtures Packages/VoyagerKit/Tests/Fixtures: stdlib ThreadingHTTPServer. It serves the JSON fixtures by method and path, and streams the .sse fixtures with a 30 ms delay per event. It accepts admin/password123 logins, returns 404 for /api/config and /api/auth/providers (the Phase 0 backend), and logs each request path to stdout. - test-ui.sh starts it, runs xcodebuild test -scheme VoyagerUI with launch arguments -VoyagerBaseURL http://127.0.0.1:8765 -UITestReset 1, and stops it. - The smoke flow (iPhone and iPad): login → onboarding skip → Explore search submit → the first section appears in under 3 s → select a hotel → My Plan shows 1 → save → Trips lists the plan → Chat Q&A reply → Alerts tab → You → switch to dark and to German. On iPad, rotate and change to a 1/3-width split; the results stay. It ends with XCTApplicationLaunchMetric measured on the simulator, reported and not a gate.
