docs.title: Correctness
docs.text:
• Quiz rewards: retry the XP/streak award when a transient error left a finished session without rewards.
  • Head-to-head: strict 48 h expiry for an already-accepted match; h2h_complete farming with alt accounts.
  • Idea feed: stable cursor for for_you (offset over a time-dependent score), exclude blocked commenters from counts, a report on an approved item should not permanently shield it from auto-hide, repeat reports should not burn the daily report quota.
  • Comments and h2h lists keep showing a handle after the author goes private; account delete leaves reports rows about the deleted profile and remix_of.handle in copied plans.
  • Save, unsave, save again creates a new plan each time (cap it).
  • A restricted user can still edit bio/handle, like, follow and report.
  • avatar_url embeds the internal user id; serve avatars by handle or an opaque token.
  • Idea snapshot size check should measure the JSON, not str(snap).

docs.title: Phase 5 — Social + Play Implementation Plan
docs.text:
For agentic workers: use superpowers:subagent-driven-development. Steps use - [ ] checkboxes. Commit author and committer must be exactly rupakc <4364388+rupakc@users.noreply.github.com>; verify with git log -1 --format='%an <%ae> / %cn <%ce>' before the first push.

Goal: profiles, an ideas feed with real moderation, daily quiz and topic packs, asynchronous head-to-head, weekly leaderboards and challenges, all safe by default and costing no live AI calls.

Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-10-voyager-reimagined-design.md §5, §5a (Social and Play rows), §11. Contract (binding, written first): docs/Social-API.md. Build on app/game/ (engine, rules.json, hide_game), docs/Sharing-API.md, docs/Notifications-API.md.

docs.title: Owner-question rulings (main controller, 2026-11-12)
docs.text:
1. Two flags, both default false until the final review: SOCIAL_ENABLED (profiles, feed, moderation) and PLAY_ENABLED (quiz, h2h, boards, challenges; also needs GAME_ENABLED). Off: routes 404, features.social|play = 0, the SPA hides entry points. Final task flips both if the review is clean.
  2. Identity. A user-chosen handle is the only public identity (never username/email). No profile exists until the user creates one; default visibility private; each extra field is its own opt-in; leaderboards opt-in. A handle can change once per 30 days.
  3. Moderation without AI cost. Spec §2a mentions a Flash-Lite classifier. Ruling: this phase ships a deterministic keyword filter (reject list, review list, URL/email-like tokens held), reports (auto-hide at 3 distinct verified reporters), blocking, per-user limits, restrictions and an admin queue, and no model call. An optional classifier is a follow-up behind the same hook (services/moderation.py::classify). Unverified users cannot publish ideas or comments.
  4. hide_game scope. The setting is labelled "Hide Play & points", so it hides Play, XP, level, badges and leaderboards (routes 403 game_hidden, excluded from boards, no quiz notifications, no game fields on their profile). The feed and profiles are social, not game, and remain. One-line change if the owner reads it wider.
  5. Quiz bank is committed data, no AI. backend/app/game/quiz/bank.json (entities: countries with capital, landmarks with country, dishes with country) plus a deterministic generator. Prompts are templates translated in the SPA (play namespace); country names are localised from countries.csv; capital, landmark and dish names ship in English (with optional per-language names where known, English fallback). Packs: flags, capitals, landmarks, cuisine. Etiquette and "where is this" images are deferred (need curated content and image rights). Bank minimum: 80 countries with capitals, 40 landmarks, 40 dishes, every country alpha-2 valid; a test checks consistency and that every distractor pool has >= 3 entries.
  6. Scoring is server-side: 100 per correct plus up to 50 speed bonus linear over 15 s, computed from server timestamps. Daily quiz = same five questions per UTC day (seeded by date), once per user. XP values in the contract; streak quiz via touch_streak.
  7. Leaderboards score = the ISO week's quiz and h2h points. Global is opt-in only (top 50); friends = people I follow (approved) plus me. Handles only.
  8. Weekly challenge = five questions about the country of the user's next upcoming trip when the bank has >= 3 entries for it, else a featured pack of the week (deterministic by ISO week). Computed from existing trips data; no new tables for it beyond sessions.
  9. Head-to-head is asynchronous, 48 h expiry, limits 5 open and 10 per day, only against non-private, unblocked handles; opponent score hidden until both finish; both get h2h_complete XP.
  10. Remix reuses utils/remix semantics server-side: saving an idea creates a new plan in the saver's account from the whitelisted snapshot. The author earns idea_saved once per (saver, idea), never for self-saves, only from verified savers. No XP for posting, liking, following or commenting.
  11. Limits: ideas 5/day, comments 30/day, reports 20/day, follows 200/day, h2h 10/day; sizes: title 80, caption 500, comment 300, bio 160, note 200, snapshot 64 KB. Buckets social_write 30, social_read 120 per 10 min, play 60, plus admin for the queue. Tests run with limits off, plus one test that enables them.
  12. Rendering: all user text plain, escaped by React, no dangerouslySetInnerHTML, no markdown, no auto-links. Public surfaces stay behind sign-in and carry no OG data (feed is not crawled).
  13. Notifications use notify_center.enqueue_category with dedupe keys (social: idea saved, new follower; quiz: h2h invite/result). Text via the shared catalog in 7 languages.
  14. Sharing kinds quiz and status extend Phase 4's POST /shares additively (see contract). Telemetry enums grow additively.

docs.text:
• Two-way compatibility (CLAUDE.md): additive schema (CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS; new tables join the GCS/VM user-table backup set like shares), no existing route changes shape, the SPA feature-detects features.social|play and tolerates the old backend, old SPA unaffected.
  • Telemetry: closed registry additions with matching docs/Telemetry.md rows (registry test): social_profile_view, social_profile_save (visibility), social_idea_publish (kind), social_idea_open, social_idea_like, social_idea_save, social_comment, social_follow (state), social_report (target,reason), social_block, social_feed_view (scope), play_state_view, play_quiz_start (mode,pack), play_quiz_answer (correct: bool, elapsed_s: int), play_quiz_done (mode,correct: int), play_h2h_create, play_h2h_open, play_h2h_result (winner enum), play_board_view (scope), play_challenge_view, admin_mod_action (action). No handles, ids or text. Every control has data-tid.
  • i18n: new lazy namespaces social and play (plus game badge names and notification templates) in all 7 languages; register in routeNamespaces.js and index.js globs; catalog.test.js green. Informal es/de, vous fr.
  • Theme tokens only (light default, dark supported), 16px mobile gutters, reduced motion respected, buttons >= 44px.
  • Gates per PR: ruff check backend/, cd backend && python3 -m pytest -q, cd frontend && npx eslint src/ --max-warnings 0 && NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-require-module npm test (frontend PRs), mkdocs build --strict.

docs.title: Phase 6 — Notifications Implementation Plan
docs.text:
For agentic workers: use superpowers:subagent-driven-development. Steps use - [ ].

Goal: Immersive, respectful notifications. Server-side categories, quiet hours and caps; localized trip-phase pushes (T-30, T-7, T-1, morning brief); price drops that respect the same controls; APNs for iOS (inert until the owner sends an Apple key); one client contract for iOS and Android.

Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-10-voyager-reimagined-design.md §7, §5a, §6 (anti-spam), §8, §11 row 6. Builds on: services/push.py (FCM), alert_delivery.py (quiet hours/caps/outbox, shared), alerts_db.alert_prefs, notifications_db, devices_db, Phase 2 trip_prep/trip_phase/trip_snapshots.

docs.title: Rulings (prudent defaults; owner can change by config)
docs.text:
1. Flag. NOTIFICATIONS_V2_ENABLED (settings.notifications_v2_enabled, default false; switched on after the final review). The new routes always exist. The flag gates only behaviour: category checks on price pushes, the trip-push loop, and APNs/FCM routing by platform. Off = today's behaviour byte for byte. GET /config gains features.notifications_api: 1, features.notifications_v2: bool, features.apns: bool (key configured).
  2. Categories (per-user toggles, all default on): price_drops, trip_reminders (T-30/T-7/T-1), morning_brief, weather, nearby (a client-side switch the apps honour for on-device local notifications; the server never sends it), plus reserved social, quiz (stored and returned, no sender until Phase 5).
  3. One source of truth for quiet hours: they stay in alert_prefs.quiet_hours (Phase 3). The new settings routes read and write that same value, so both UIs agree. Quiet window is evaluated in the account timezone. With no timezone, quiet hours are not applied, and the morning brief is skipped; T-x reminders go out from 09:00 UTC.
  4. Caps. New global daily_cap (int 1–10, default 3) counts non-price pushes per user per local day. Price drops are exempt from it and keep Phase 3's per-kind caps. Held-over-quiet items are re-checked against the cap when released.
  5. Held items. A push in quiet hours is held until the window ends and sent then; if held more than 12 h it is dropped. The in-app row is always written, and the user sees it in the notification list.
  6. Dedupe. One push per (user, plan, kind) ever, enforced by a unique key in a new notify_log table. Morning brief is per (plan, local day).
  7. Localization. Text is rendered server-side from services/notify_text.py in the 7 languages: user setting language, else the newest device locale, else en. The same templates are served by GET /notifications/catalog so apps localize on-device notifications from one source.
  8. Location privacy. The server never receives or stores location, and nothing location-like enters telemetry. "Localized recommendations" are (a) the morning brief, using the plan's own destination, today's itinerary slot and a static country tip; (b) on-device "near you" notifications built from the catalog template and the existing /nearby (coarse place data). The contract tells apps not to send coordinates anywhere new.
  9. Gamified touches. The morning brief deep-links to Today (check-in). Push text never mentions streaks or points, and never shows a "streak at risk" nudge (guardrail: never punishing). With hide_game no game wording appears at all.
  10. APNs is built (services/apns.py, ES256 JWT via PyJWT, HTTP/2 via httpx[http2]) and inert until APNS_TEAM_ID, APNS_KEY_ID, APNS_KEY_P8 (or APNS_KEY_FILE) and APNS_BUNDLE_ID (default io.github.rupakc.travelplanner) are set; APNS_SANDBOX toggles the host. /devices additively accepts platform: "ios". Tests use httpx.MockTransport, never Apple.
  11. Deferred (follow-ups): live weather-change detection (needs a polling budget; weather covers the T-1 and morning-brief weather line from the stored snapshot), web push (VAPID), social/quiz senders, notify_log per-day analytics.

The new SPA on the old backend hides the section (feature-detect features.notifications_api).

New events: notif_settings_view {}, notif_category_toggle {category: enum, on: bool}, notif_quiet_hours_change {enabled: bool}, notif_cap_change {cap: int}, notif_open {category: enum, source: enum push|inapp} (for apps on tap). docs.title: API contract (docs/Notifications-API.md, additive-only once merged)
docs.text:
All under /api, bearer auth, Phase 1 error envelope {"detail","error_code"}.

  • GET /notification-settings → {"categories": {"price_drops": {"enabled": true}, "trip_reminders": {...}, "morning_brief": {...}, "weather": {...}, "nearby": {...}, "social": {...}, "quiz": {...}}, "quiet_hours": {"enabled": true, "start": "22:00", "end": "07:00"}, "daily_cap": 3, "timezone": "Asia/Kolkata"|null, "quiet_hours_active": bool, "push": {"fcm": bool, "apns": bool}, "devices": 2}.
  • PUT /notification-settings (any subset of categories.<name>.enabled, quiet_hours fields, daily_cap; timezone, quiet_hours_active, push, devices read-only and ignored) → same object. 422 notification_settings_invalid.
  • GET /notifications/catalog?locale=xx → {"locale": "es", "templates": {"nearby_arrival": "Estás cerca de {place}: {item} está a {minutes} min", …}} (every template the server sends plus on-device ones; unknown locale → en).
  • POST /devices accepts platform: "android" | "ios" (APNs token as hex string).
  • Notification rows (/notifications) and push data gain category and plan_id; kinds trip_t30, trip_t7, trip_t1, trip_morning. link is a web path (/trips/{id}, /trips/{id}/today); apps map it.
  • Delivery order for category pushes: user enabled? → dedupe → quiet hours (hold) → global cap → send. Price drops: price_drops enabled? → Phase 3 rules.

docs.text:
For agentic workers: use superpowers:subagent-driven-development. Controller rules: .superpowers/controller-rules.md (git identity rupakc <4364388+rupakc@users.noreply.github.com>, one worktree per implementer, ≤ 3 subagents, ~/.local/bin/gh pr checks <n> --watch --fail-fast --interval 60, merge only on exit 0). Repo rupakc/travel-planner-ios, one PR per task. This plan builds on 2026-11-11-ios-app.md (conventions, module graph, the CI(...) and snapshot-recording convention) and assumes its Tasks 1-37 are merged, including T30 (FeatureShare viewer), T32 (FeatureAlerts), T33 (NotificationsCore), T35 (FeatureSettings), T14 stubs and T38 smoke suite, plus the Phase 1+2 adoption (Trips with Today/Recap, account settings). It does not redo them; it extends them.

Goal: the iOS app adopts the frozen contracts Alerts-API.md (P3), Sharing-API.md (P4), Notifications-API.md (P6), Social-API.md (P5), all in ~/travel-planner/docs/. Order: P3, P4, P6, P5. Model: the Android plan ~/travel-planner-android/docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-13-android-phase3-6-parity.md (same breakdown; rulings reused where they fit). Web scope and rulings: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-12-phase{3,4,5,6}-*.md and their follow-ups, docs/Feature-Parity.md. Authority: the spec 2026-11-10-voyager-reimagined-design.md.

docs.title: Global constraints (in addition to the iOS plan's)
docs.text:
• Mixed versions. Read GET /config features: alerts_api (2), price_alerts_v2, live_prices, sharing (0/1), notifications_api, notifications_v2, apns, social, play (0/1), game. Never call a route whose flag is absent or 0; the older backend gets today's screens, silently, no retry storm. Unknown JSON keys, notification kinds and categories, advice codes and share kinds are ignored (an unknown share kind is a plain link). /config is cached 5 min server-side, so a 404 from a flagged route degrades that feature off for the session.
  • Server decides. The app never recomputes verdicts, advice codes, savings, scores or quiz points and never calls SerpAPI or any price source. Exception: the quiet-hours evaluator used for on-device notifications (R10), tested against the golden file.
  • Wording. "Caught a drop of $X", never "saved". Every price shows its age (checked_days_ago); checks_paused says live checks are paused, never "great price now"; an estimate is labelled "estimate" and never counts. No currency conversion: total_usd plus by_currency lines.
  • hide_game (features.game false or the account setting) hides XP, badges, levels, boards, Play and all game wording, in notifications too. An unreadable setting counts as hidden for game wording.
  • Credentials do not exist (SerpAPI, APNs, FCM, SMTP, Meta). Everything is config-gated and inert; tests use fakes (MockURLProtocol, Fake*Repository, FakeNotificationCenter, FakeClock, FakeShareCardLoader, FakeLocationProvider, a fake APNs payload). No test reaches a real network.
  • Strings in all 7 languages (en es de fr hi zh bn). Web namespaces on main already cover most copy (priceStory, dropMoment, savings, quickWatch, watchSuggest, alertPrefs, alertsHub, share, notifications, social, play, socialShare, playYou, game; adminSocial is out of scope). Only mobile-only keys that no web namespace has go into the web mobile namespace in all 7 languages (Task 0a, dropped if nothing is missing), then scripts/upstream/sync.sh re-vendors. i18n/pending/en stays empty. Server error codes are translated; the backend detail is the fallback. Missing key falls back to English, never the raw key. User-facing text only through L10n.
  • Telemetry only events in the vendored registry, platform: "ios", enum/bool/int props, no PII, no handles, ids, tokens, share URLs, free text or location; every control gets a tid through the Task 13 modifier; calls are synchronous and non-throwing for the caller. Events: alert_story_view, alert_target_set, alert_advice, alert_drop_seen, alert_quick_watch, alert_suggest, alert_savings_share, alert_prefs_change, alert_digest_open (P3); share_open|create|action|revoke (P4; share_view is SPA-only); notif_settings_view|category_toggle|quiet_hours_change|cap_change|open (P6); social_profile_view|profile_save|follow|block|feed_view|idea_publish|idea_open|idea_like|idea_save|comment|report, play_state_view|quiz_start|quiz_answer|quiz_done|h2h_create|h2h_open|h2h_result|board_view|challenge_view (P5, all in the registry on main). Props exactly as the Telemetry.md rows; TelemetryPropsTests rejects anything else.
  • Privacy. No location goes to any new endpoint or telemetry. Share defaults stay private. Cached shared cards and downloaded PNGs live in NSTemporaryDirectory()/share-cards and are purged at sign-out and launch.
  • A11y and adaptive. Dynamic Type to AX5 without clipping primary actions, VoiceOver labels on every icon-only control, 44 pt targets, Reduce Motion respected, light default and dark supported, iPad (sheets as popovers or form sheets, two-column lists where it fits). Every network screen has loading, empty, error-with-retry; a 429 shows the backend detail.
  • Per-user local data is cleared by sign-out (the existing session cleaner).
  • Each task: tests first, CI(<Target>Tests) green with 0 swiftlint warnings, snapshots recorded per the iOS plan's convention and each PNG viewed before commit (iPhone light, iPhone dark, hi/de long-string, AX5, iPad where listed), docs touched (docs/Modules.md, Telemetry.md, Localization.md, Privacy-Labels.md, reference/api-contract.md), and MEMORY.md for each ruling.

docs.title: Rulings
docs.text: # Ruling Why Cost if wrong R1 Task 0 lands everything shared once: package targets, routes, deep links, flag struct, per-phase stub files (VoyagerModel/PhaseN/, VoyagerData/PhaseN/, VoyagerEnv/PhaseN/, TestSupport/PhaseN/, tools/stub_backend/phaseN.py), the Settings and AppShell rows, one upstream sync each phase's core task then replaces only its own stubs, so the three cores and all UI tasks touch disjoint files rebase churn R2 Price story chart uses Swift Charts (system framework, not third-party): LineMark for points, RectangleMark for the typical band, chartXSelection scrubbing, AXChartDescriptorRepresentable for VoiceOver, plus "first check" and "latest" accessibility actions no new dependency; a11y; matches the iOS plan's one-third-party rule a custom Canvas later R3 One-tap watch and suggestions show only when live_prices and (price_alerts_v2 or alerts_api >= 2); stories, savings and the digest show from stored data regardless contract client notes none R4 Drop moment shows the notification's own data.game.xp (award plus badge) only when game is visible; never a client sum the web follow-up left it open; server value is truth copy tweak R5 Share is route-based: entry points call router.open(.shareSheet(target)), FeatureShare owns the sheet. Two buttons: "Share link" (ShareLink(item: url, preview: SharePreview(title, image: card thumbnail))) and "Share image" (ShareLink of the size=story PNG as a Transferable). The card is downloaded with the app's URLSession only when its host is the base URL or a trusted host, else link only; a failed download shares the link only. Instagram Stories / TikTok are out (Meta App ID, developer apps: owner items) features never import each other; SSRF-safe; contract defers the rest a later add-on R6 Opening share links: onOpenURL accepts https://<trusted host>/share/<token> (live once the owner's associated domains exist) and voyager://share/<token>; My shares has an "Open a link" PasteButton(payloadType: URL.self) (no paste-permission prompt). The in-app view is FeatureShare (GET /share/{token}, public) AASA is an owner action; paste always works chooser to Safari R7 Notification settings live in You > Notifications (T35's NotificationsSection row opens .notificationSettings). Quiet hours are one server value shared with alert prefs: either screen saves through its own route and both refetch. The nearby category is a local switch, also PUT to the server. The screen shows the iOS permission state with an "Open Settings" action, push.apns false as an honest "push is not set up on this server yet" note, and the device count contract; iOS permission is separate none R8 Taps: trip_* rows and pushes open Trips Today by plan_id (fallback: trip detail, then the inbox); an empty plan_id opens the inbox; link is only ever mapped through DeepLinks allow-listing (/trips/{id}, /trips/{id}/today, /feed and /feed/{id}, /u/{handle}, /play/h2h/{id}, /share/{token}, /alerts; today the social kinds' link is /feed, a richer link is a web follow-up, so an unresolved one opens the Ideas tab), never opened raw; an unknown kind shows a generic inbox row. Foreground presentation honours the category switch; notif_open is sent on tap with source push or inapp the Phase 6 follow-up asked clients to confirm this wrong screen on tap R9 No duplicate or rule-breaking local notifications. The server always writes an in-app row, even when quiet hours, caps or categories suppressed the push. So AlertPoller must pass every row through NotificationGate (category enabled, quiet hours via the evaluator, daily_cap for non-price kinds, instant=targets_only) and a held row is scheduled for the window's end; and when server push is live (features.notifications_v2 and push.apns and a registered device) the local TripReminderScheduler drops its T-7, T-1 and morning reminders (keeps checkout) and the poller drops to the T48 safety net the T33 poller and reminders predate categories; without this a phone buzzes at 03:00 or twice wrong silence or double buzz R10 "Near you" is built on-device from GET /notifications/catalog?locale= (nearby_arrival, cached per locale in Caches, bundled English fallback in mobile) plus the existing POST /nearby call. When-in-use permission only: it is evaluated when the scene becomes active during an active trip phase (no Always permission, no geofencing, no background location), at most one per ~500 m cell per 6 h, never inside local quiet hours, only when the nearby switch is on, shown as a local notification (foreground banner). No coordinates in any new call or telemetry iOS cannot do background proximity with when-in-use; honest and privacy-first fewer triggers than Android R11 QuietHours.evaluate(now, timezone, quiet) lives in Domain and passes quiet_hours_cases.json (vendored golden); timezone == nil means not applied contract golden cases none R12 New targets FeatureSocial (profile, follows, blocks, feed, ideas, comments, reports) and FeaturePlay (quiz, head-to-head, boards, challenge); they do not import each other. AppShell composes: Ideas as a segment next to "Surprise me" in the Discover tab; Play as a section of the You tab; profile and follow requests under You. Admin moderation UI is a non-goal (like admin) module graph; admin non-goal a later module R13 UGC safety (App Store 1.2): every user string renders with Text(verbatim:), no markdown, no links, no data detectors; report (7 reasons enum-mapped) on every idea, comment and profile; block (two-way, silent); the held and hidden states have honest copy; a one-time community-rules acceptance before the first profile save or post (UserDefaults, per user); a support contact row (owner supplies the URL; row hidden while empty).
